input.subject: 19 Coppice Road – job HC-14-310 (ref R/14): invoice check, please hold payment
input.body:
Dear Ms Ferrer,

Re: 19 Coppice Road, Ludlow Heath, ZZ5 7ZZ – immersion thermostat/element replacement, job HC-14-310 (our ref R/14).

We've checked the invoices received on 6 October against your approval (Thermo-Serve Ltd, quote £210). We received two invoices for this same job, both dated 6 October:
- TS-0881 from Thermo-Serve Ltd, £175.00 + £35.00 VAT = £210.00. This matches your approval.
- TS-0882 made out to "H&S Domestic Services", £270.00 + £54.00 VAT = £324.00, including 2 hours of extra labour. The payee is not the contractor you approved, the amount is £114 above the approved £210, and the extra labour was not approved.

Because there are two invoices for one job, please don't pay either of them for now. Paying both would mean paying twice for the same work. We're asking Thermo-Serve Ltd which invoice is correct and who issued TS-0882. A colleague will be in touch with what we find and what we recommend. If Thermo-Serve or anyone else contacts you directly asking for payment, or asking you to pay a different account, please let us know before you pay.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.subject: Job HC-14-310, 19 Coppice Road: please clarify invoices TS-0881 / TS-0882
input.body:
Hello Thermo-Serve Ltd,

Re: 19 Coppice Road, Ludlow Heath, ZZ5 7ZZ, job HC-14-310 (our ref R/14), immersion thermostat and element replacement attended on 25 September.

On 6 October we received two invoices from your email address for this job:
- TS-0881: payee Thermo-Serve Ltd, £210.00 including VAT. This matches the approved quote.
- TS-0882: payee H&S Domestic Services, £324.00 including VAT, which adds 2 hours of extra labour.

Please confirm:
1. Which invoice is the correct one, and whether the other should be withdrawn.
2. Whether H&S Domestic Services is connected to Thermo-Serve Ltd, and whether TS-0882 was issued by you.

The landlord approved £210 only. Extra labour was not approved, so we can't pass on any amount above that without a separate approval. Payment is on hold until we hear back from you.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
